evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet logic in 'src/wallet/wallet.cpp' and 'src/wallet/wallet.h' to suppress periodic rebroadcast and mempool resubmission.
rationale: Prevents the wallet from re-adding dropped transactions to the mempool during startup, imports, and periodic rebroadcast loops when configured with '-privatebroadcast'. Without this fix, wallet transaction rebroadcasts leak transaction ownership against user privacy expectations.
